fields.topic: SiC stiffness, strength and size transfer
fields.finding: 410 GPa is a comparison input versus 430 GPa in the vendor sheet. Nominal 3.9 GPa compression and projected 15.586 MPa tension do not establish full-size member allowables or frame failure probabilities.
fields.action: Obtain matched finished-tube compression/tension distributions, flaw and size effects, load interaction, and joint-contact evidence. Keep probability and qualified allowable fields null.
